related.title: 鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復
related.transfer: 可遷移「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」與「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" and "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以面板厚度、肋—面板部分滲透焊、焊接變形與組裝精度控制，製作能承受數億次輪載的輕量鋼橋面；鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復則以由細節類別、應力範圍與斷裂力學判斷鋼橋裂縫的風險，選擇止裂孔、錘擊或拼接補強並訂定追蹤週期為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deck-plate thickness, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, distortion and fit-up control that produce a light steel deck able to survive hundreds of millions of wheel passes; Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair centres on judging steel-bridge crack risk from detail category, stress range and fracture mechanics, then choosing arrest holes, peening or splices and setting follow-up intervals, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」與「蓋板端部焊趾」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” and “Cover-plate end weld toe”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 正交異性鋼橋面板製作
history.text: 德國工程師 Wilhelm Cornelius 於 1948 年提出以正交異性鋼橋面建造懸索橋並建立分析方法，戰後德國重建的大量鋼橋使這種輕量橋面迅速成熟。1975 年溫哥華 Lions Gate 橋北側高架段以正交異性鋼橋面取代混凝土橋面，是北美首例；1982 至 1986 年金門大橋在不封閉道路的情況下，利用 401 個夜間把原混凝土橋面分 747 段換成正交異性鋼橋面，橋面重量減輕約 12,300 噸（美噸）。早期部分橋面的肋—面板焊縫出現疲勞裂縫，促使業界提高面板厚度並控制焊縫熔深，FHWA 於 2012 年出版正交異性鋼橋面設計、施工與維護手冊整合這些經驗；2004 年通車的 Millau 高架橋則擁有面積極大的正交異性鋼橋面。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: German engineer Wilhelm Cornelius proposed a suspension bridge with an orthotropic steel deck in 1948 and developed methods to analyse it, and Germany's post-war rebuilding of many steel bridges quickly matured this light deck. In 1975 the north viaduct of Vancouver's Lions Gate Bridge replaced its concrete deck with an orthotropic steel deck, the first in North America; from 1982 to 1986 the Golden Gate Bridge replaced its concrete deck in 747 sections over 401 nights without closing the roadway, cutting deck weight by about 12,300 US tons. Fatigue cracks at the rib-to-deck welds of some early decks led the industry to thicker deck plates and controlled weld penetration, experience that FHWA consolidated in its 2012 manual on the design, construction and maintenance of orthotropic steel deck bridges, while the Millau Viaduct, opened in 2004, carries a very large orthotropic deck. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
